cues.zh: 我们当然极力想避免它，但往往躲不掉，原因有很多且很充分：
cues.en: We're desperate to avoid it of course, but we won't, for a lot of very good reasons:

cues.zh: 我们并不了解自己
cues.en: We don’t understand ourselves

cues.zh: 我们都有着各自独特的毛病：神经质、不平衡、不成熟……
cues.en: We're all crazy in very particular ways: neurotic, unbalanced and immature...

cues.zh: 但我们却不清楚细节，
cues.en: But we don’t know the details,

cues.zh: 因为没人会认真鼓励我们去探究。朋友们只想对我们友善，
cues.en: because no one encourages us too hard to find out. Our friends just want to be kind and have

cues.zh: 一起找点乐子。而敌人根本不愿费这个劲。
cues.en: fun with us. Our enemies don't want to waste the trouble.

cues.zh: 结果就是自我认知极度匮乏，我们根本不知道自己和谁合得来。
cues.en: So we end up with such a poor level of self-understanding, we have no clue who we'd be compatible with.

cues.zh: 早期约会吃晚餐时，一个标准问题本该简单直接：“你哪方面不正常？”
cues.en: A standard question on any early dinner date should simply be: ‘how are you mad?’

cues.zh: 但要认清这点太难了……
cues.en: But it's so hard to know...

cues.zh: 其次，我们并不了解别人
cues.en: Secondly, we don’t understand other people

cues.zh: 看清别人的古怪毛病，就像看清自己一样难，他们伪装得太好了
cues.en: It's as hard to work out the craziness of other people as it is our own, they put on such a good show

cues.zh: ——起初是这样。
cues.en: - at first.

cues.zh: 理想情况下，我们需要让他们和我们自己完成一系列心理问卷
cues.en: What we'd ideally need is to send them and us through a battery of psychological questionnaires

cues.zh: 并接受四年的密集心理治疗，包括个人治疗和伴侣治疗——然后再做出
cues.en: and have four years of intensive psychotherapy, individual and couples' based - before reaching

cues.zh: 决定。
cues.en: a decision.

cues.zh: 到2100年，这听起来就不再像玩笑了——人们只会纳闷
cues.en: By 2100, this will no longer sound like a joke - people will merely wonder why

cues.zh: 为什么人类花了这么久才走到这一步。
cues.en: took humanity so long to get us here.

cues.zh: 我们不习惯幸福
cues.en: We aren’t used to being happy

cues.zh: 我们以为自己想要幸福，但我们真正想要的是自己熟悉的东西——而那通常
cues.en: We think we want happiness, but what we really want is what we're used to – and that usually

cues.zh: 根本不包含太多幸福。
cues.en: doesn't involve too much happiness at all.

cues.zh: 成长过程中，我们大多数人的爱都掺杂了其他更阴暗的东西：被控制、
cues.en: Growing up, most of us had our love mixed in with other, darker stuff: being controlled,

cues.zh: 感到屈辱、被抛弃或被虐待。简而言之，就是痛苦。而现在，无论我们
cues.en: feeling humiliated, being abandonned or abused. In short, suffering. And now, whatever we

cues.zh: 嘴上怎么说，那才是我们大多仍在寻找的东西。
cues.en: may say, that's what we're mostly still on the look out for.

cues.zh: 这就解释了为什么我们拒绝了所有那些候选人，那些心智成熟、可靠、情绪稳定的人，
cues.en: It explains why we rejected all those candidates, the well-balanced, mature reliable ones,

cues.zh: 总觉得他们有点“无聊”。
cues.en: as somehow a bit 'boring'.

cues.zh: 也解释了为什么我们反而暗戳戳地扑向那些潜意识里明知
cues.en: - and why we head instead with secret energy to those characters we unconsciously know

cues.zh: 会用我们无比熟悉的套路把生活搞得一团糟的人。
cues.en: will mess us up in such cosily familiar ways.

cues.zh: 单身太难熬了，
cues.en: Being single is so awful

cues.zh: 你必须能坦然面对空虚的周六夜晚、持续的疏离感和毫无性生活，
cues.en: You have to be very at peace with empty Saturday evenings, constant alienation and sexlessness

cues.zh: 才能以正确的方式去精挑细选。
cues.en: in order to be choosy in the right way.

cues.zh: 难怪我们大多数人都是半闭着眼，抓到什么算什么。
cues.en: No wonder most of us half shut our eyes and grab what's there.

cues.zh: 直觉被赋予了过高的光环，
cues.en: Instinct has too much prestige

cues.zh: 婚姻过去是一桩理性的买卖；全看父母怎么把自家地块
cues.en: Marriage used to be a rational business; all to do with your parents matching their bit

cues.zh: 和邻居家的拼在一起。冷酷算计得可怕。
cues.en: of land with the neighbours'. It was horribly cold and calculating.

cues.zh: 所以现在我们有了浪漫主义婚姻。理应全凭感觉，绝不该
cues.en: So now we have romantic marriages. It's meant to be all about how you feel. You should never

cues.zh: 思前想后。去理性分析这个决定，瞬间就显得“不浪漫”了。
cues.en: think too much. To analyse the decision immediately feels ‘un-Romantic’.

cues.zh: 说实话，最浪漫的做法可能就是特别突然地求婚，也许
cues.en: Indeed, the most Romantic thing to do may just be to propose really suddenly, perhaps

cues.zh: 仅仅几周之后——凌晨3点在拉斯维加斯的小教堂里……
cues.en: after only a few weeks - in a chapel in Vegas at 3am...

cues.zh: 这种疯狂似乎矛盾地预示着婚姻本身会是个明智的决定。
cues.en: The madness seems a paradoxical sign that the marriage itself will be a sensible idea.

cues.zh: 并不会。
cues.en: It won't be.

cues.zh: 我们不上爱情学校
cues.en: We don’t go to Schools of Love

cues.zh: 我们没有任何信息。
cues.en: We don't have any information.

cues.zh: 我们不上课，不和已婚夫妇交流，还刻意远离离过婚的人。
cues.en: We don't take classes, we don't talk to married couples and steer very clear of divorced ones.

cues.zh: 所以我们步入婚姻时，并不知道婚姻真正失败的原因——除了我们以为的
cues.en: So we go into it without knowing why marriages really fail – beyond what we take to be

cues.zh: 那些其他夫妻单纯的愚蠢，而我们跟他们完全不一样。
cues.en: just the simple stupidity of all those other couples we're not like at all.

cues.zh: 冻结幸福
cues.en: Freezing happiness

cues.zh: 你想让美好的事物永久留存：你在威尼斯，在泻湖上，无忧无虑，
cues.en: You want to make nice things permanent: you're in Venice, on the lagoon, with no responsibilities,

cues.zh: 夕阳把金屑洒满海面，即将在小
cues.en: the evening sun throwing gold flakes across the sea, the prospect of dinner in a little

cues.zh: 鱼餐厅吃晚餐，你心爱的人穿着羊绒毛衣依偎在你怀里……
cues.en: fish restaurant and your beloved in a cashmere jumper in your arms…

cues.zh: 你结婚，就是为了让那种感觉永久留存。
cues.en: You get married to make that feeling permanent.

cues.zh: 但这一切都会过去，真正永恒的是伴侣——只是现在心境完全不同了。
cues.en: But it all goes and what is really permanent is the partner - but now in a very different mood.

cues.zh: 你想不再去想爱情
cues.en: You want to stop thinking about Love

cues.zh: 太痛苦了：心碎、约会、一夜情……
cues.en: It's such a pain: the heartache, the dating, the one night stands...

cues.zh: 你想彻底摆脱这一切。你结婚，就是为了不必再时时刻刻想着爱情。
cues.en: You want shot of it all. You marry to stop having to think about love all the time.

cues.zh: 正因如此，你会嫁错人——或者也许已经错了。
cues.en: All of which is why you'll marry the wrong person - or perhaps have done so already.

cues.zh: 但这真不是你的错。从来没人教过我们该怎么做这件事，所以
cues.en: But it's not really your fault. No one ever teaches us how to do this thing, and so of

cues.zh: 我们当然会搞砸。
cues.en: course we crash.

cues.zh: 作为一个物种，我们终将学会。这种漫不经心的疯狂不能继续下去。太多人
cues.en: We will, as a species, eventually learn. The careless madness can't go on. Too many people

cues.zh: 受到伤害。
cues.en: get hurt.

cues.zh: 至少再过几个世纪，我们就会摸到门道——这是肯定的。
cues.en: In a few centuries at least, we'll be getting the hang of it - for sure.
